summary: Re-ran the molecular tests for M4-S05 (After-update Apex trigger on Case completing the First Response milestone, plus its test class) after four repairs since the last test run (F-59 TestUserFactory/System.runAs, F-60 fixture-seeding scope, F-61 process-name filter, and F-62 -- the first repair to touch shipped code: CaseMilestoneService's CaseMilestone SELECT and Database.update now run WITH SYSTEM_MODE / AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE). check-outputs confirmed all 8 declared outputs present, non-empty and parseable. The always-on xml check parsed all 5 *-meta.xml files under artefacts/M4-S05/ (TestUserFactory.cls-meta.xml now included alongside the four from the prior run). The always-on manifest check recorded skipped-not-applicable per the Apex exception (standards/build-orchestration.md section 5), naming M5-S05 as the step that aggregates the ApexClass/ApexTrigger members. The declared checker (skills/apex/entitlement-apex-hooks/scripts/check_entitlement_apex_hooks.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M4-S05) exited 0 over 5 Apex files (0 ERROR, 0 WARN). The one manual acceptance test was checked against the Given/When/Then shape, found usable (one Given, one When, one Then naming two observable outcomes), and deferred to skipped_manual[] for the milestone gate. At the caller's request, the undeclared skills/apex/test-class-standards/scripts/check_test_class_standards.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M4-S05/classes was also run informationally (exit 0, score 100) and is recorded in tests/M4-S05/summary.md only -- it is not a plan-declared acceptance test and does not appear in results.json ran[]/failed[]. All plan-declared tests passed; status set to tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran or was correctly classified as manual, both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (checker exit 0, check-outputs ok, ElementTree parse success on all 5 meta files). No command test was refused, no manifest exclusion was needed beyond the already-settled Apex exception, and check-outputs reported no missing/empty/malformed output. Per step-tester's Step 7 override of the default rubric.

process_observations.observation: The prior results.json (run 2026-09-12T08-45-00Z) was overwritten rather than trusted: it recorded 4 Apex files and predated F-59 through F-62, which added TestUserFactory.cls, restructured the test's runAs boundary, tightened the process-name filter, and moved CaseMilestoneService onto an explicit system-mode boundary. Re-running from a fresh check-outputs call and a fresh checker invocation is what surfaced the correct file count of 5 and confirmed the checker still clears every rule after the system-mode change.

check_entitlement_apex_hooks.py's EAH005 rule (no WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED) and EAH006 rule (CompletionDate = NULL filtering) both still clear after F-62 introduced WITH SYSTEM_MODE / AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE -- a different clause the checker does not flag one way or the other, so the 0 ERROR / 0 WARN result is not silently masking a rule that stopped applying.

classes/TestUserFactory.cls (added in F-59) is on disk and covered by the xml check and by the checker's 5-file scan, but it is not in this step's declared outputs[] and is therefore invisible to check-outputs and to the manifest the build-level step M5-S05 will assemble. Per the caller's brief this is M5-S05's obligation to pick up, not a defect of this step or this test run -- named here so it is not lost between the two steps.

F-62 is the first repair in this step's history to change shipped code rather than test-only code (CaseMilestoneService's query and DML). None of this agent's declared test types (checker, xml, manifest) independently re-derive whether WITH SYSTEM_MODE is the narrowest correct boundary for that write -- the checker has no rule for access-mode choice, only for the absence of WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED. The apex-builder envelope for this run already flags a security-scanner follow-up for the same reason; this agent's own test types have no way to confirm or refute that judgment.
M4-S05 is now tested; decisions.md and traceability.md were last updated before F-59 through F-62.
